content_en.title: Seafood Restaurant Website
content_en.summary: A redesign for a family seafood restaurant in five cities with a fine dining tier on the way. Guests pick seafood from the counter by weight and cooking style, see the price change by the gram, choose a table on a floor plan, and the order lands on the branch's weighing board.
content_en.challenge:
The old site promised that guests could choose their own fresh seafood, but it showed no prices. Seafood sold by weight is exactly where guests worry about the bill, and the site gave them nothing to estimate it with.

Reservations ended in a WhatsApp chat with each branch, with no view of tables, times or orders. A popup asking guests to pick between the family restaurant and the premium tier appeared before any content, and parts of the site still carried sample reviews and unfinished content.
content_en.solution:
The site works like a point-of-sale screen opened up to guests: navigation on the left, work in the middle, the order on the right. A weight slider picks an actual whole fish or a quantity of shellfish, and the price formula updates with each step. The same order carries through to the floor plan.

Staff get a captain's tablet with table status, three stages from weighing to serving, a field for the actual weight that shows the price difference, and counter stock that falls as items are confirmed. Planned stack: Next.js, Supabase, an admin panel for daily prices per branch, and official WhatsApp notifications.
features: Counter prices per 100 g, by branch
Weight slider with live price formula
Cooking style selection with visible fees
Order carried from counter to reservation
Floor plan reservations with private rooms
Weighing board with actual weight and price difference
Counter stock tracking with low-stock flags

content_id.title: Website Restoran Seafood
content_id.summary: Redesign untuk restoran seafood keluarga di lima kota dengan tier fine dining yang akan dibuka. Tamu memilih seafood dari etalase per berat dan cara masak, melihat harga berubah per gram, memilih meja di denah, dan pesanannya masuk ke papan timbang cabang.
content_id.challenge:
Situs lama menjanjikan tamu bisa memilih sendiri seafood segar, tetapi tidak menampilkan harga. Seafood yang dijual per berat justru membuat tamu khawatir soal tagihan, dan situs tidak memberi cara untuk memperkirakannya.

Reservasi berakhir di chat WhatsApp per cabang, tanpa gambaran meja, jam, atau pesanan. Pop-up pilihan restoran keluarga dan tier premium muncul sebelum konten, dan sebagian situs masih memuat ulasan contoh serta konten yang belum selesai.
content_id.solution:
Situs bekerja seperti layar kasir yang dibuka untuk tamu: navigasi di kiri, kerja di tengah, nota di kanan. Slider berat memilih ikan utuh yang tersedia atau jumlah hasil laut curah, dan rumus harga berubah di setiap langkah. Nota yang sama terbawa sampai denah meja.

Staf mendapat tablet kapten dengan status meja, tiga tahap dari timbang sampai antar, kolom berat aktual yang menunjukkan selisih harga, dan stok etalase yang berkurang saat item dikonfirmasi. Stack rencana: Next.js, Supabase, panel admin harga harian per cabang, dan notifikasi WhatsApp resmi.
features: Harga etalase per 100 g, per cabang
Slider berat dengan rumus harga langsung
Pilihan cara masak dengan biaya terlihat
Nota terbawa dari etalase ke reservasi
Reservasi di denah dengan ruang privat
Papan timbang dengan berat aktual dan selisih harga
Pelacakan stok etalase dengan penanda stok tipis
